title: Hoshino Ichika — Profile Story

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should practice introducing myself for future shows? Yeah, I remember us doing this once before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Now that we've gone pro...?
Right, okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
I'm Ichika Hoshino, the singer and guitarist for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also write songs and lyrics for our band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Despite having done this kind of talk countless times by now, I can't help but feel nervous doing it in front of a camera.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What else should I talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? What I like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, that sounds good.
Then, I'll try talking about Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ever since I first heard one of Miku's songs when I was little, I've always loved her voice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
The first song we played together was a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really wanted to play it, so I invited Saki and the others to join me. After that, we got ourselves some instruments and began practicing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In retrospect, we weren't very good back then... But we had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I recently began making my own songs using some Miku software.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I felt bad initially because my first few attempts really didn't do Miku's voice justice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I finally managed to finish one after asking around for some advice. That was an incredible moment...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It became even more memorable after I sang that song with Miku during a show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looking back, Miku's helped connect me with so many different people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone in Leo/need, all the people who listen to our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Through music, Miku's connected me with all of them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to do the same. I want to bring people together through music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That seems like a nice place to stop. What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? It was great?
Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, um... Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to do our best as professional musicians moving forward, so we'll be looking forward to your continued support.
